title: Web page: chat + timeline picture against the existing backend

oracle_proposal.note: Medium blast radius: new route + auth surface reuse, but no touch to shared /personal auth or data migration. One critic sub-agent, grounded in real codebase reads (auth.py, sarfgraphmodel.py, schema.py).
oracle_proposal.posted_to_note: NOT posted as a Jira comment this run: team-lead's ground rules restrict Jira writes to reads + one closing comment. Proposal + ratification recorded here and in the committed oracle file instead.
oracle_proposal.proposed_criteria_summary: 17 criteria from the critic, reconciled to 17 ratified criteria (C1-C17) in the oracle file.
oracle_proposal.ratification_note: Ratified by the coordinator (fd360b) under team-lead's explicit pre-authorization to proceed autonomously while Patrick is away, NOT by Patrick's own direct yes on this criteria set. Documented as a deviation in the oracle file and to be flagged in the PR/report.

criteria.text: Page loads on 8889 sandbox; login works; user's own diagram loads.
Chat message returns a coach reply through the existing ask()/Discussion/Statement pipeline.
Per-person step line reflects only that person's own directed events, correctly isolated from other people (avoids the known QML mixed-sum bug).
auth.py / is_personal_app_request untouched by this unit's diff; existing /personal/* HMAC-only enforcement unchanged.
New chat-send route rejects a forged cross-origin POST (CSRF).
3-point line rule: <3 directed points = dots only; 3+ = line bounded to its own point range.
Certainty rendering: Certain=sharp mark, Approximate=~1yr band, no-date=undated shelf only.
Gap renders visually distinct from a recorded no-change (same-direction) mark.
Strip scale (resting, <=2 lanes) shows only line/dots/amber-? -- no bands/fades/ticks.
Expanded full view exists: more lanes, labels, bands, undated shelf as chips.
Tap-a-mark shows a plain one-sentence description, read-only.
Lane picker offers exactly the diagram's real people/pair-bonds.
No silent stale read immediately after an extraction-triggering chat exchange.
Responsive layout works at mobile (390px) and desktop widths.
Automated tests exist under btcopilot/btcopilot/tests/personal (or training) covering C1-C9,C12,C13.
Seed fixture: 5+ people, 2 couples, 20+ dated events, mixed certainty incl. approximate+undated, exercising every rule above.
Manual walkthrough per the Manual Testing Protocol on 8889 (snapshot+screenshot+interactions).

findings.summary: Personal QML app's own timeline (_calculateCumulative in sarfgraphmodel.py) mixes all people's deltas into one running sum -- not per-person. New page must not reproduce this.
findings.repro: Inspect familydiagram/pkdiagram/personal/sarfgraphmodel.py _calculateCumulative; it keeps 3 scalars summed across every event regardless of person.

findings.summary: btcopilot/auth.py dispatches by URL path prefix; a naive session-auth 'bridge' placed inside the shared authenticator would weaken auth for the live Personal QML app's /personal/* calls.
findings.repro: Read btcopilot/auth.py current_user()/is_personal_app_request()/_authenticate_pro_personal_apps(): HMAC-only, hard 401, no session fallback, chosen purely by request.path prefix.

findings.summary: flask_wtf CSRF is initialized app-wide but the training blueprint's own CSRF hook is currently commented out; a new session-authenticated mutating route needs its own protection or it's a new hole.
findings.repro: Read btcopilot/training/routes/__init__.py _csrf_protect(): body is fully commented out.

findings.summary: Extraction runs async (Celery); a chat reply and the PDP commit it triggers are decoupled in time, so the timeline endpoint can be queried before the delta lands.
findings.repro: Read btcopilot/personal/deepreextract.py and personal/__init__.py init_celery -- extraction is a background task, not inline with the chat reply.
